The '''Ghoop Ocean''' was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] with choppy waters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. In the culture of the native [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Species/Legends|species]], during body preparation for funeral services, hooks with inscribed iron balls would be placed under the skin of the deceased before their bodies would then be dropped into the ocean.<ref name="NEGTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ghoop Ocean was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="NEGTC" />
